notes.title: New Release - Hector: Badge of Carnage - Episode Two, 25% off Full Series!
notes.notes:
The second episode for Hector: Badge of Carnage is now on Steam for Mac & PC. Pick up the Full Series for 25% off until September 1st at 10AM Pacific Time!

He’s violent, drunken, and has a taste for all things criminal, corrupt, or smothered in curry. Guide Detective Inspector Hector through a hostage crisis in the centre of Clappers Wreake, a town that took the “Great” out of Britain.
